title: macaranga corymbosa
intro: Macaranga corymbosa, commonly known as the 'Bael Tree' or 'Crape Myrtle', is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Macaranga corymbosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable remedy for managing pain and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
